actual_tool_arguments.prompt:
Redesign the FIRST reference image, S3-06, as one finished concept illustration for a Chinese VDot engineering report. Preserve only its correct subject and relationships: INT8 input, a common C interface, a compile-time choice of either VDot OR RVV, and a common result layout. Freely replace the whole former icon composition. The SECOND reference is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: borrow its warm off-white, graphite, pale warm gray and restrained vermilion, fine straight rules, equal-weight subjects and confident legible typography. Do not copy its DiffTest content, title or its two simultaneously executing branches.

This new figure must make a MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE COMPILE-TIME IMPLEMENTATION CHOICE immediately clear. Use a different arrangement from the style reference: a narrow left interface column and a broad right alternative-choice area, with the shared result underneath. Left column: INT8 输入 above C 接口, connected by a clean short downward arrow. One fine rightward arrow leaves C 接口 and enters the broad choice area as a whole. Above this area, a modest vermilion heading 编译时选择 with a short thin underline. Within that ONE shared selection area, set VDot and RVV as equal-sized typographic alternatives side by side in matching pale warm-gray flat regions, with a large clearly readable 或 between them. The two alternatives are NOT connected to one another. Do not draw a split that feeds both implementations, and do not use separate output arrows from each implementation. A SINGLE clean arrow from the selection area as a whole leads downward into one broad unboxed shared-result grouping labeled 相同结果布局. The choice area's outer grouping may be indicated by one fine bracket or rule; do not clutter it with nested box borders. Keep the connector routing unmistakable and leave ample whitespace. The actual build selects one implementation; this is not runtime dispatch, a CPU feature probe, a UI toggle, or two engines running together.

Exact visible text, once each: INT8 输入; C 接口; 编译时选择; VDot; 或; RVV; 相同结果布局. No other words, no title, no figure number, no caption. No input matrix grids or output bit subdivisions: exact dimensions and 128-bit slot rules remain in the report prose. This is an undimensioned concept proof, not a bit-accurate diagram, waveform or measurement plot.

Art direction: landscape around 1600 x 1000, opaque warm-white #F6F3EE background; graphite #242424 text and connectors; pale warm-gray #E8E3DC for alternatives; restrained vermilion #CE4B32 only for compile-time selection emphasis. Flat clean solid fills; no gradients, texture, drop shadows, glow, 3D or cartoon imagery. No chips, files, sockets, gears, magnifying glasses, badges or decorative unlabeled squares. No giant banner headline. Strong modern sans-serif Chinese similar to Noto Sans CJK; main labels approximately 52–64 px and smallest labels at least 42 px at this size, so every word is clear at 160mm printed width. Equal size and weight for VDot and RVV, no superiority colors or performance claims. Both choices use the same ordinary C-call contract and shared result layout; no PASS, checkmark, benchmark numbers, new test assertion or automatic fallback. All text fully inside the frame, no line through any label. Deliver one refined editorial composition that reads as an interface with an alternative implementation choice, visibly different from the two-independent-model diagram of the second reference.
